_comment: Rules of skill R. A rule computes only if status is VERIFIED-REOPENED or ENGINEERING RULE; a [CHECK] rule is disabled and the script prints [CHECK].

rules.reason: revenue = patients x share x adherence x price per patient-year; the eligible-population by treatment-share structure follows the payer-side budget-impact method (context VP-R-050, VP-R-051) but no published standard prescribes this seller-side arithmetic
rules.gap: no standard for deal-level revenue arithmetic

rules.reason: list price must carry a reference and a date on or before the reference date, or be marked a team assumption; public list sources and their limits are described in references/source-register.md
rules.gap: no standard; public price pages differ by country

rules.passage: Net prices are not observable from public list sources: arrangements are often confidential (Europe), and the German negotiations are confidential by statute; US net prices differ from list by rebates.

rules.reason: because net is not public (FC-NET-NOT-PUBLIC) it is an assumption range set by a named deal-team member and labelled so (owner ruling R2)
rules.gap: no source gives a country-by-country net-to-list ratio

rules.passage: no default net-to-list ratio is registered
no default uptake curve or time to peak is registered
no default erosion curve (price or volume) is registered for either small molecules or biologics

rules.reason: linear ramp over years_to_floor from the year after the exclusivity end, applied to price and volume separately; parameters are the team's, with a source reference
rules.gap: context only: generic price falls with the number of generic producers (VP-R-001, VP-R-002, VP-R-004) and biosimilar entry lowers price per DDD (VP-R-010); none gives a ramp shape

rules.reason: owner ruling R4: unrisked revenue; probability of success is displayed alongside and never applied; risk-adjusting belongs to the future deal valuation capability
owner ruling R4: undiscounted revenue; discounting belongs to the future deal valuation capability
owner ruling R3: US, DE, FR, IT, ES, UK country by country; there is no EU price; other markets are a GAP
each country in its own currency; a conversion needs a dated, sourced rate supplied by the team; nothing is converted or inflated

rules.passage: Published forecasts of sales have run high in one country's reimbursement dossiers and in a consensus-forecast sample; no error band is applied.

rules.reason: owner ruling R1: Market Access outputs appear only as side-by-side cross-check columns, never merged, and count only when the pack is Released
owner ruling R5: the forecast the deal team adopts is HUMAN ONLY; ranges only, never a point
